notes.title: About Demo & 0.40 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42385448/05db1c45b0f74232376c0a085660efe89be227a7.png[/img]

Goodfellas,

We intended to remove the demo after Steam Next Fest. However, we chose to keep the demo up and running for a longer period of time. We've had amazing feedback from the demo, which really is helpful. We plan to offer core mechanical improvements via demo rather than open beta tests. With your help, we hope to increase the amount of feedback and test opportunities that we can offer. We believe it will allow us to address in advance for the majority of problems that may develop in the early access phase. We will continue to provide improvements to the demo through the end of the month. Perhaps we can extend this period until early access.

Thank you very much for your feedback and encouragement. Please share your ideas with us in the Steam discussion section.
 
[i]Update notes;[/i]
 
[b]v0.39 - v0.40[/b]
[list]
[*] Quests now start automatically after starting the game.
[*] The tutorial screen is now displayed when the demo starts.
[*] When you enter a specific area, AI will now attack you.
[*] Units that are not engaged in combat will now holster their weapons.
[*] Health regen is now shown in HP bars.
[*] Added new Steam Achievements.
[*] Three new car models have been added to traffic.
[*] Some barrels can now be blown up. (It appears that they can be attacked while hovering)
[*] Vehicles can now explode if they are damaged.
[*] FPS indicator removed. You may enable it by pressing "T" and typing "fps" into the Cheat Menu.
[*] UI changes have been made.
[*] Map improvements have been made.
[*] Optimization improvements have been made.
[*] A issue that caused units to attack from too far away has been fixed.
[*] The bug that allowed you to attack enemies in unseen locations has been fixed.
[*] Some camera limit bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

[b]v0.40.1 - hotfix[/b]
[list]
[*] Some bugs in the achievements have been fixed. ("The New In Town" achievement is still buggy.)
[*] Fixed a bug that caused units to become stuck after battle.
[/list]
